compiled_state.description:
## Context
Cloud and DC need one provider-neutral definition of logical identity, attempts, delay, ambiguity, and terminal outcome before either adapter can remove nested retries.

## Outcome
Add immutable operation/outcome values and the sole three-invocation, 15-second cumulative-sleep budget. Establish ADR 0100 as a provisional S1 decision record; adapter and dispatch wiring remain later tasks.

## Plan
1. Define typed values for logical id, desired postcondition, invocation/request counts, disposition, failure scope, replay safety, delay source/value, `retry_not_before`, and bounded redacted diagnostics.
2. Implement a fake-clock budget with at most three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep. Use `2**(attempt+1)+U[0,1)`: [2s,3s), then [4s,5s).
3. Treat authoritative provider delay as a lower bound. If it cannot fit, return `retry_not_before` without sleep or fictional attempt.
4. Define ambiguity decisions: observed desired state is recovered success; conclusive old state may replay; failed/inconclusive observation is non-replaying `commit_unknown`.
5. Seed ADR 0100 with retry ownership, Jira no-idempotency constraint, observe-before-replay, lifecycle owners, and selected-route-only deltas.

## Testing
Use deterministic UUID/jitter/fake-clock tables. Assert every field, deadline, count, and diagnostic bound.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Outcome objects expose all named provider-neutral fields with deterministic serialization.
- [ ] One logical id remains stable across every physical invocation.
- [ ] No budget permits more than three invocations or 15 seconds cumulative sleep.
- [ ] Fallback delays remain [2s,3s) then [4s,5s).
- [ ] Over-budget authoritative delay returns `retry_not_before` without sleeping or incrementing an attempt.
- [ ] Ambiguity decisions distinguish recovered success, safe replay, and non-replaying `commit_unknown`.
- [ ] ADR 0100 records the provisional contract and ownership boundaries.

## Out of scope
Cloud/DC execution and legacy dispatch integration are later S1 tasks.
